text:
Priya S: Heads-up: HelixAI reached out — they want their 6B open model on our Marketplace. Theyre asking for hosted listing + optional HW bundle later with our appliance partners. Need to decide distribution policy and announcement plan.
Marco G: Thanks. Do they allow weight downloads? Thats the big gating item for legal/export.
Priya S: Helix prefers hosted-only to start. Theyre open to limited SI POCs that run locally, but no unrestricted weight distribution.
Linda T: Hosted-only keeps things simpler. For SI demos we can provide a network-proxy POC container (no weights) that calls our inference endpoint. That satisfies many on-prem proof needs.
Ravi P: Ops note  if we offer an SI POC we should tag it as "proxy-only" and require a time-limited license. Also add canary routing and reduced token caps during POC.
Marta (marketing): Timeline ask from Helix: coordinated launch with SI on May 2. Marketing wants final copy + two demo clips by Apr 18. Legal sign-off needed Apr 4. Feasible?
Marco G: Legal sign-off by Apr 4 doable if Helix signs addendum within 5 business days. Ill draft: hosted-listing terms, explicit no-download clause, SI POC license, export compliance block, and an academic research carve-out.
legal-bot: Reminder: use the "marketplace-hosted-v2" template for hosting-only model partners. Include export-control paragraph and KYC for SIs.
Priya S: Helix asked for a light academic exception: labs allowed to run small experiments (non-commercial). Can we add a limited research license for universities only?
Marco G: Yes, propose: "Academic non-commercial research allowed with attribution, not for redistribution or commercial hosting." Will require Helix confirmation.
Ravi P: Tech constraints  add a compatibility note for HW bundles: quantization supported (4-bit profile), min GPU mem 10GB for local inference shim, and note that we dont ship weights in any bundle.
Linda T: Also include a telemetry opt-in question: who can access demo telemetry? Recommend Redwood default owns telemetry; partner can opt-in to aggregated metrics sharing. Put explicit opt-in checkbox on the addendum.
Marta (marketing): For Marketplace SKUs suggest: 1) "HelixAI Hosted (API)" 2) "HelixAI - Hosted + SI POC (Proxy)" 3) "HelixAI - Partner HW Bundle (coming soon)" Pricing TBD. Include a short 2-line blurb for the listing.
Priya S: Good SKU names. Ops: well need a canary route and auto-fallback to baseline model X to protect SLAs. Ops team wants a 7-day validation window before full traffic.
Ravi P: A/B rollout plan + fallback implemented. Also document rate-limit tiers for POC SKUs so SIs don't blast tokens in demo.
Marco G: Ill include a code-style clause for non-distribution in the draft: 
```nNo redistribution: Licensee shall not reproduce, distribute, or otherwise make the Model Weights available to third parties. Permitted: hosted inference through Redwood API; time-limited on-prem POC using proxy container under NDA.
```
Marta (marketing): Can someone supply two 1280x720 screenshots and a 10s demo clip (no logs, anonymized) for the listing? Prefer neutral UI with Redwood branding.
Linda T: I can capture sanitized screenshots from the demo harness and a short GIF. No weights or raw request payloads included.
Priya S: Action items: Marco to post draft addendum by Tue; Linda to deliver demo assets by Fri; Marta to draft marketplace copy and PR outline after legal draft; Ops (Ravi) to prepare canary + fallback config and validation plan. Helix will confirm academic carve-out separately.
Marco G: ACK.
Ravi P: ACK, will schedule validation window.
Linda T: ACK, will scrub assets.
Marta (marketing): ACK, will draft the blurb.
Priya S: Thanks all. Ill set a weekly check-in until launch. :sparkles:
